title: Edge reveal
description: The next view uncovers the current one; both stay sharp and stationary.

mechanism.timeline: Let p run from 0 to 1 over 260 ms. Forward navigation: incoming opaque image is clipped to x=(1-p)*W through W; outgoing opaque image is clipped to x=0 through (1-p)*W. Reverse navigation mirrors both clips. Opacity remains 1 and translation remains zero throughout. The two rectangles meet exactly, so no text overlaps and no background gap opens.
mechanism.direction: Forward uncovers from the right edge toward the left; back uncovers from the left edge toward the right.
mechanism.notes: Keep the viewport and tabs fixed. At rest, remove the outgoing layer. For rapid reversal, preserve the current seam coordinate and animate it back rather than restarting at an edge.

title: Clipped push
description: The next view pushes the previous one aside as one continuous surface.

mechanism.timeline: Let p run from 0 to 1 over 300 ms. Inside one overflow-hidden viewport, outgoing image translates from x=0 to x=-W*p while incoming image translates from x=W to x=W*(1-p). Images remain opaque and equal-size, touching at the shared boundary. Reverse navigation mirrors both transforms. Do not scale or fade either layer.
mechanism.direction: Forward pushes left; back pushes right.
mechanism.notes: This is intentionally more spatial than Edge reveal, so the user can judge whether visible travel helps. No overshoot or trailing shadow. Preserve the current translation on interrupted reversal.

title: Quiet replace
description: A brief, stationary replacement with no lateral travel or overlapping text.

mechanism.timeline: 0-60 ms: outgoing image opacity goes from 1 to 0, incoming remains at 0. At 60 ms: outgoing is removed and incoming begins immediately, with no blank hold. 60-160 ms: incoming opacity goes from 0 to 1. Both images stay at x=0, y=0; the stable viewport background remains visible beneath them. Do not crossfade the text layers.
mechanism.direction: No directional movement; same behavior in both directions.
mechanism.notes: The deliberately short 160 ms duration distinguishes this from the rejected slow fade-through. Keep it a one-shot replacement and avoid an initial empty frame.
